source.title: Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("District Councils": nominations with labels, withdrawals, and "Newry")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name and label read from the page image; no contest after withdrawals, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1902; two councillors for each division. Killyman: "as no nominations were received for this district, the old councillors stay on" (not named, not filed). The Lisnadill (A. M'Kenna, B. O'Toole, D. M'Parland, all N.) and Middletown (P. M'Donald, J. Quinn, P. Corr, all N.) contests were not found in the reports read and are not filed. Returned unopposed.
